name: Ankh Do
description:
A pharaonic to-do list for the top bar.

Drag tasks into order, time them with a per-task stopwatch, undo deletions, and drive everything from the keyboard — in a calm night-lapis and gold theme.

Keys: ↑/↓ move, Alt+↑/↓ reorder, Space done, Enter/F2 edit, T timer, C copy, Delete delete, Esc back.

Tasks stay on your machine (~/.config/scroll-of-deeds/tasks.json). The clipboard is used only to copy a task's text when you press its copy button or C.
